_meta.name: onboarding-cross-training
_meta.deskripsi: 30-day onboarding + cross-training + admin_polyvalent_track. V3: Admin (Novita/Sinta) wajib polyvalent 4 skill dalam 3 bulan (meeting 24 Jul 2026 point 9).
_meta.ref: content/v2-developer/bab-29-onboarding.md + revisi 24 Jul 2026 + meeting 24 Jul 2026 point 9

admin_polyvalent_track_v5.filosofi: Admin V4 = filing robot, stuck di 1 skill. Admin V5 = polyvalent yang bisa cover 4 area: Customer Service, KPP (Komunikasi, Pemberkasan, Pembayaran), Legal draft ringan, Konten support. Dalam 3 bulan = certified polyvalent.
alasan_polyvalent: Backup plan kalau admin resign/cuti (zero single-point-of-failure)
Career path untuk admin (dari P0 ke P1 lebih cepat)
Perusahaan lebih fleksibel (1 orang bisa cover 2-3 fungsi)

skill_4_area.definisi: Handle customer complaint, after-sales response, satisfaction survey, komplain handling
skill_4_area.metrik_kelulusan: Response time < 30 menit, komplain resolved 95%+ dalam SLA
skill_4_area.durasi_belajar: Bulan 1 (1 minggu shadow + 1 minggu eksekusi supervisi)

skill_4_area.definisi: KPP = Komunikasi + Pemberkasan + Pembayaran. Handle kelengkapan berkas FLPP, komunikasi bank, tracking pembayaran, follow-up konsumen
skill_4_area.metrik_kelulusan: Berkas 0 reject, on-time submission 100%, lead time < 14 hari kerja
skill_4_area.durasi_belajar: Bulan 1-2 (cross training dengan admin senior / Bu Nisya)

skill_4_area.definisi: Draft surat sederhana, draft klausul tambahan yang sudah ada template, review kontrak template (bukan create from scratch)
skill_4_area.metrik_kelulusan: Draft review-approved Bu Nisya 90%+ (tidak perlu banyak revisi), zero error fatal
skill_4_area.durasi_belajar: Bulan 2 (2 minggu shadow Bu Nisya + 2 minggu eksekusi supervisi)

skill_4_area.definisi: Support tim media: caption writing, broadcast WA template, repost story, dokumentasi visual (foto, video simple)
skill_4_area.metrik_kelulusan: Caption approved Rifki/Reni 85%+, broadcast on-time, dokumentasi event lengkap
skill_4_area.durasi_belajar: Bulan 3 (1 minggu shadow Reni + 2 minggu eksekusi + 1 minggu mandiri)

timeline_3_bulan.bulan_1: Skill 1 (CS) + Skill 2 (KPP) — fokus dual skill paling kritikal
timeline_3_bulan.bulan_3: Skill 4 (Konten support) — finalisasi, plus ujian polyvalent
timeline_3_bulan.ujian_polyvalent: Akhir bulan 3: Novita/Sinta presentasi 4 skill ke Mada + Bu Nisya + owner. Lulus = sertifikat + naik ke P1 senior admin. Tidak lulus = extend 1 bulan + coaching.

polyvalent_certified_benefit.grading: Naik P0 → P1 senior admin (gaji pokok +Rp 300rb, tunjangan +Rp 200rb)
polyvalent_certified_benefit.fee_lebih_tinggi: Mel/closing file naik 50% (Novita Rp 200rb → Rp 300rb, Sinta Rp 150rb → Rp 225rb)
polyvalent_certified_benefit.job_title: Bisa pakai title 'Senior Admin' di LinkedIn/business card
polyvalent_certified_benefit.career_path: P1 senior admin → P2 admin manager (jika tim admin > 3 orang)

tracking_per_bulan.report_mingguan: Novita/Sinta submit update ke Mada setiap Jumat
tracking_per_bulan.report_bulanan: Mada rekap ke owner + Bu Nisya (legal anchor)

onboarding_30_hari.agenda: Orientasi umum: profil perusahaan, struktur, SOP, dashboard V2, K3
onboarding_30_hari.output: New hire paham big picture, akses dashboard, tanda tangan kontrak

onboarding_30_hari.agenda: Pelajari SOP divisi sendiri + cross-training 1 divisi lain (1-2 jam/hari)
onboarding_30_hari.output: PIC bisa eksekusi task dasar divisi sendiri

onboarding_30_hari.agenda: Eksekusi task dengan supervisi (1-on-1 dengan kepala divisi)
onboarding_30_hari.output: PIC eksekusi 80% task dengan supervisi minimal

onboarding_30_hari.agenda: Eksekusi task mandiri + rotasi ke divisi backup (cross-training)
onboarding_30_hari.output: PIC eksekusi 100% task mandiri, kenal 1 divisi backup

onboarding_30_hari.agenda: Evaluasi 30 hari + KPI baseline + feedback dua arah

probation_3_bulan.evaluasi_bulanan: Mada + kepala divisi lakukan review 1-on-1 setiap akhir bulan
probation_3_bulan.kpi_baseline: SOP compliance, response time, inisiatif, kerja sama tim
probation_3_bulan.outcome: Lolos probation = kontrak 1 tahun perpanjang. Tidak lolos = exit interview + pesangon sesuai UU

Riza_DigitalMarketing.primary_skill: Ads management, content kalender, KOL outreach
Riza_DigitalMarketing.backup_pic: Yudi/Sdek (operasional marketing harian jika Riza izin)

Mada_ChiefofStaff.primary_skill: Operasional harian, lintas divisi, eksekusi strategis
Mada_ChiefofStaff.backup_pic: Pak Ardian (jika Mada cuti/izin) + Bu Nisya (legal operations)
Mada_ChiefofStaff.periode_rotasi: Tetap, by exception jika Mada off

Rizal_ProyekTripleRole.primary_skill: Site manager, RAB, strategic planning, PIC utama proyek
Rizal_ProyekTripleRole.backup_pic: Amir (cover harian) + Mada (strategic decision saat Rizal cuti > 3 hari)

Yudi_Sdek.backup_pic: Reta (back-up closing) + Riza (backup digital marketing jika Yudi cover closing)

Rifki_MediaKreatif.primary_skill: Desain grafis, video editing, social media content

Reni_MediaBroadcast.primary_skill: Broadcast WA, social media engagement, KOL outreach

Reta_ClosingEngagement.primary_skill: Closing customer, broadcast, social proof, dokumentasi

Novita_Admin.primary_skill: Administrasi umum, absensi, arsip, customer service

BuNisya_Legal.primary_skill: Legal oversight, kontrak, izin, BPN tracking
BuNisya_Legal.backup_pic: Pak Ardian (jika Bu Nisya cuti, untuk legal approval) + Novita (admin legal ringan)

PakArdian_Owner.backup_pic: Bu Nisya (jika Pak Ardian off) + Mada (eksekusi harian)

q3.agenda: SOP proyek update untuk Rizal + Amir
Closing script + objection handling untuk Yudi + Reta
Konten kreator upskill untuk Rifki + Reni

q4.agenda: Leadership training untuk Mada + Bu Nisya
Customer service excellence untuk Novita + Reni
Cross-training batch 2: Reta + Yudi ke marketing, Sinta + Novita ke legal
